method: DIFFERENT FROM AUTHOR: (1) Enumerate product workflows (audit, fit-changed, graph-build+rules, yagni, sim, query-only) and ask which logical stage is missing. (2) Stress-test per-relation Coverage with mixed languages under P-4. (3) Ask how PS-07 could be gamed or is untestable without a planner debug hook.
whatCouldHaveFailed: Missing admission/config-resolve stage that creates PlanId
PS-07 impossible without non-deterministic planner internals
Reduction forced into a sixth public stage

workflowCoverage.workflow: graph impact query on stored view

workflowCoverage.stages: mutation outside this schema + verification run stages
workflowCoverage.note: Mutation is command class, not plan stage — OK

workflowCoverage.detail: Plan construction (resolve config, admit extensions, allocate PlanId) is a real step with failures (request-rejected). It may be *before* the plan DAG rather than a stage kind — if so, state explicitly that admission is pre-plan host work, not a sixth stage. Silence will grow a sixth kind later.

exhaustiveness.verdict: Five kinds are sufficient for analysis execution if admission is explicitly pre-plan. Without that sentence, exhaustiveness is not sealed.

perRelationCoverage.detail: Under P-4 (TS+Rust semantic, other languages syntax), a single stage-level Coverage bit cannot express 'syntax complete for Go, resolved unavailable for Go, resolved complete for TS'. Per-relation is mandatory. Prefer per-relation **per language** in the next field-level schema (P-4 loud tier).

ps07Testability.detail: PS-07 requires two Plans that differ only in private operators. Without a test-only planner hook to force operator selection, implementers will either skip PS-07 or expose private operators in the public schema. Required: a conformance harness API forcePrivateOperatorSet(ops) available only in test builds, OR redefine PS-07 as 'digest invariant under store warmth / shard count' which is already LN-06 territory.

sealC2.substance: Approve five kinds + private operators + per-relation Coverage + query-never-runs-analysis

knownLimitations: Did not draft field-level JSON schemas for each stage.
